title: One clue or many?

doesNotKnow: The second panel contains several stipulated fossil forms, while the first contains one. An assemblage offers more kinds of evidence, but this does not prove all organisms lived together or that sampling is complete.

misconception: The first apparent interpretation is the only possible one.
objective: One fossil is compared with a group of several fossil types from a stated single layer. Which gives a broader view of the sample?
